scopes.label: Editor
scopes.reason: Everything under src/common/editor/ that is not controller, command or engine code: models, workers, storage, effects and import/export, where an unexercised branch corrupts a user's project.

scopes.label: Editor core
scopes.reason: The controller, command and engine trees decide what every edit does, so they hold their own branch floor instead of averaging into the far larger editor scope.

scopes.label: Desktop
scopes.reason: The desktop main process and its helpers reach the real filesystem and the native runtime, so an untested branch there escapes the browser sandbox.

scopes.label: Framescaper
scopes.reason: Framescaper's own tree, still growing feature-first; the floor tracks what the ratchet has claimed rather than an aspiration.

scopes.label: Soundscaper
scopes.reason: Soundscaper's own tree: thin product wiring over the shared editor, so its floor is set by what that wiring actually exercises.

scopes.label: Common transfer
scopes.reason: Project archives and session transfer are the durable interchange surface; a regression here is a file a user can no longer open.

scopes.label: Common site
scopes.reason: The marketing and documentation site is mostly presentational markup, so its line floor is low while its branches stay covered.

scopes.label: Common i18n
scopes.reason: Catalog loading and message resolution are small, pure and exhaustively testable, so they are held near total line coverage.

scopes.label: Common offline
scopes.reason: The offline shell and its caches decide whether a returning user has an application at all, and its failure paths are hard to observe in production.

scopes.label: Shared root
scopes.reason: The small shared modules at the root of src/ and src/common/ are depended on by both products, so every branch of them is cheap to cover and expensive to break.
